messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++11 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

<perturbed_code_1>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
#define For(i,a,b) for(int i=a;i<b;i++)
#define pb push_back
#define mod 1000000007
#define reset(s,val) memset(s,val,sizeof(s))
#define eps 1e-8
#define pi acos(-1)
#define sqr(x) (x)*(x)
#define two(x) (1<<(x))

long long p,k,vst[1000006],ans;

long long f(long long x,long long y){
    long long res=1;
    for(long long i=30;i>=0;i--)
    {
        res*=res;
        res%=mod;
        if((1ll<<i)&y) res*=x;
        res%=mod;
    }
    return res;
}

int main( ){
    ios::sync_with_stdio(0);
    ans=0;
    cin>>p>>k;
    if(k==1)
    {
        cout<<f(p,p);return 0;
    }
    For(i,1,p) if(!vst[i])
    {
        vst[i]=1;
        ans++;
        long long cur=(i*k)%p;
        while(!vst[cur])
        {
            vst[cur]=1;
            cur=(cur*k)%p;
        }
    }
    cout<<f(p,ans);
}
